record.bible_text: Now when these things were done<WH03615><WTH8763>, the princes<WH08269> came<WH05066><WTH8738> to me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, The people<WH05971> of Israel<WH03478>, and the priests<WH03548>, and the Levites<WH03881>, have not separated<WH0914><WTH8738> themselves from the people<WH05971> of the lands<WH0776>, <FI>doing<Fi> according to their abominations<WH08441>, <FI>even<Fi> of the Canaanites<WH03669>, the Hittites<WH02850>, the Perizzites<WH06522>, the Jebusites<WH02983>, the Ammonites<WH05984>, the Moabites<WH04125>, the Egyptians<WH04713>, and the Amorites<WH0567>.

For they have taken<WH05375><WTH8804> of their daughters<WH01323> for themselves, and for their sons<WH01121>: so that the holy<WH06944> seed<WH02233> have mingled<WH06148><WTH8694> themselves with the people<WH05971> of <FI>those<Fi> lands<WH0776>: yea, the hand<WH03027> of the princes<WH08269> and rulers<WH05461> hath been chief<WH07223> in this trespass<WH04604>.

And when I heard<WH08085><WTH8800> this thing<WH01697>, I rent<WH07167><WTH8804> my garment<WH0899> and my mantle<WH04598>, and plucked off<WH04803><WTH8799> the hair<WH08181> of my head<WH07218> and of my beard<WH02206>, and sat down<WH03427><WTH8799> astonied<WH08074><WTH8789>.

Then were assembled<WH0622><WTH8735> unto me every one that trembled<WH02730> at the words<WH01697> of the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, because of the transgression<WH04604> of those that had been carried away<WH01473>; and I sat<WH03427><WTH8802> astonied<WH08074><WTH8789> until the evening<WH06153> sacrifice<WH04503>.<CM>

And at the evening<WH06153> sacrifice<WH04503> I arose up<WH06965><WTH8804> from my heaviness<WH08589>; and having rent<WH07167><WTH8800> my garment<WH0899> and my mantle<WH04598>, I fell<WH03766><WTH8799> upon my knees<WH01290>, and spread out<WH06566><WTH8799> my hands<WH03709> unto the LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, <RF>heaviness: or, affliction<Rf>

And said<WH0559><WTH8799>, O my God<WH0430>, I am ashamed<WH0954><WTH8804> and blush<WH03637><WTH8738> to lift up<WH07311><WTH8687> my face<WH06440> to thee, my God<WH0430>: for our iniquities<WH05771> are increased<WH07235><WTH8804> over<WH04605> <FI>our<Fi>  head<WH07218>, and our trespass<WH0819> is grown up<WH01431><WTH8804> unto the heavens<WH08064>. <RF>trespass: or, guiltiness<Rf>

Since the days<WH03117> of our fathers<WH01> <FI>have<Fi> we <FI>been<Fi> in a great<WH01419> trespass<WH0819> unto this day<WH03117>; and for our iniquities<WH05771> have we, our kings<WH04428>, <FI>and<Fi> our priests<WH03548>, been delivered<WH05414><WTH8738> into the hand<WH03027> of the kings<WH04428> of the lands<WH0776>, to the sword<WH02719>, to captivity<WH07628>, and to a spoil<WH0961>, and to confusion<WH01322> of face<WH06440>, as <FI>it is<Fi> this day<WH03117>.

And now for a little<WH04592> space<WH07281> grace<WH08467> hath been <FI>shewed<Fi> from the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>, to leave<WH07604><WTH8687> us a remnant to escape<WH06413>, and to give<WH05414><WTH8800> us a nail<WH03489> in his holy<WH06944> place<WH04725>, that our God<WH0430> may lighten<WH0215><WTH8687> our eyes<WH05869>, and give<WH05414><WTH8800> us a little<WH04592> reviving<WH04241> in our bondage<WH05659>. <RF>space: Heb. moment<Rf> <RF>a nail: or, a pin: that is, a constant and sure abode<Rf>

For we <FI>were<Fi> bondmen<WH05650>; yet our God<WH0430> hath not forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> us in our bondage<WH05659>, but hath extended<WH05186><WTH8686> mercy<WH02617> unto us in the sight<WH06440> of the kings<WH04428> of Persia<WH06539>, to give<WH05414><WTH8800> us a reviving<WH04241>, to set up<WH07311><WTH8788> the house<WH01004> of our God<WH0430>, and to repair<WH05975><WTH8687> the desolations<WH02723> thereof, and to give<WH05414><WTH8800> us a wall<WH01447> in Judah<WH03063> and in Jerusalem<WH03389>. <RF>to repair: Heb. to set up<Rf>
And now, O our God<WH0430>, what shall we say<WH0559><WTH8799> after<WH0310> this? for we have forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> thy commandments<WH04687>,

Which thou hast commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> by<WH03027> thy servants<WH05650> the prophets<WH05030>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, The land<WH0776>, unto which ye go<WH0935><WTH8802> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> it, is an unclean<WH05079> land<WH0776> with the filthiness<WH05079> of the people<WH05971> of the lands<WH0776>, with their abominations<WH08441>, which have filled<WH04390><WTH8765> it from one end<WH06310> to another<WH06310> with their uncleanness<WH02932>. <RF>by: Heb. by the hand of<Rf> <RF>from...: Heb. from mouth to mouth<Rf>

Now therefore give<WH05414><WTH8799> not your daughters<WH01323> unto their sons<WH01121>, neither take<WH05375><WTH8799> their daughters<WH01323> unto your sons<WH01121>, nor seek<WH01875><WTH8799> their peace<WH07965> or their wealth<WH02896> for<WH05704> ever<WH05769>: that ye may be strong<WH02388><WTH8799>, and eat<WH0398><WTH8804> the good<WH02898> of the land<WH0776>, and leave <FI>it<Fi> for an inheritance<WH03423><WTH8689> to your children<WH01121> for ever<WH05769>.

And after<WH0310> all that is come<WH0935><WTH8802> upon us for our evil<WH07451> deeds<WH04639>, and for our great<WH01419> trespass<WH0819>, seeing that thou our God<WH0430> hast punished<WH02820><WTH8804> us less<WH04295> than our iniquities<WH05771> <FI>deserve<Fi> , and hast given<WH05414><WTH8804> us <FI>such<Fi> deliverance<WH06413> as this; <RF>hast punished...: Heb. hast withheld beneath our iniquities<Rf>

Should we again<WH07725><WTH8799> break<WH06565><WTH8687> thy commandments<WH04687>, and join in affinity<WH02859><WTH8692> with the people<WH05971> of these abominations<WH08441>? wouldest not thou be angry<WH0599><WTH8799> with us till thou hadst consumed<WH03615><WTH8763> <FI>us<Fi> , so that <FI>there should be<Fi> no remnant<WH07611> nor escaping<WH06413>?

O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, thou <FI>art<Fi> righteous<WH06662>: for we remain<WH07604><WTH8738> yet escaped<WH06413>, as <FI>it is<Fi> this day<WH03117>: behold, we <FI>are<Fi> before<WH06440> thee in our trespasses<WH0819>: for we cannot stand<WH05975><WTH8800> before<WH06440> thee because of this.<CM>
